statements.status_notes: The Go vulnerability database (GO-2026-6778) places the flaw in the github.com/docker/distribution/registry/client package. The Rancher Agent links only github.com/docker/distribution/reference from this module: the symbol tables of the unstripped 2.12.16, 2.13.12, 2.14.8 and 2.15.4 agent builds, standard and FIPS, contain no registry/client symbols, and no other binary in the image carries this module.

The Go vulnerability database (GO-2026-6778) places the flaw in the github.com/docker/distribution/registry/client package. The Rancher Agent links only github.com/docker/distribution/reference from this module: the symbol tables of the unstripped 2.12.16, 2.13.12, 2.14.8 and 2.15.4 agent builds, standard and FIPS, contain no registry/client symbols, and no other binary in the image carries this module.

CVE-2026-85747 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3) is in registry/client.(*manifests).Get, which returns a manifest fetched by digest without hashing the body against the requested digest. It is fixed in github.com/distribution/distribution v3.1.2, and github.com/docker/distribution has no fixed release. go list -deps on ./cmd/scanner-trivy for harbor-scanner-trivy v0.32.4, v0.35.1, v0.39.1, v0.40.0, and v0.40.1 links only github.com/docker/distribution/registry/client/auth/challenge from that module. It does not link registry/client or registry/proxy, so the vulnerable manifest-fetch code is not compiled into the scanner-trivy binary. Advisory: https://github.com/distribution/distribution/security/advisories/GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3

CVE-2026-85747 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3) is a missing digest check in registry/client.(*manifests).Get. harbor-registry ships the goharbor/distribution registry at v2.8.3-patch-redis, and that binary registers the pull-through proxy. The proxy fetches upstream manifests through manifests.Get and caches the returned body without hashing it against the requested digest, so a malicious or intercepted upstream can substitute a digest-pinned manifest. The fix shipped in github.com/distribution/distribution v3.1.2. There is no patched 2.8 release, and this image has not moved onto that v3 module line. Advisory: https://github.com/distribution/distribution/security/advisories/GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3

CVE-2026-85747 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3) is in registry/client.(*manifests).Get, which returns a manifest fetched by digest without hashing the body against the requested digest. The bundled pull-through proxy is a caller of that method. GitLab Container Registry v4.43.0-gitlab builds ./cmd/registry, and go list -deps on that command does not include github.com/docker/distribution/registry/client or registry/proxy. The registry command does not register the pull-through proxy, so the vulnerable manifest-fetch code is not compiled into the binary. Advisory: https://github.com/distribution/distribution/security/advisories/GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3

CVE-2026-85747 is fixed in github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 v3.1.2. The kubescape binary still pulls the legacy github.com/docker/distribution v2.8.3 module transitively through docker/cli and docker/buildx, which import registry/client packages removed from the v3 module line. A go mod replace to distribution v3.1.2 fails module resolution for those docker/cli imports during go/bump. Remediation requires upstream kubescape or its docker/buildx and docker/cli dependencies to migrate to releases built against distribution v3.

CVE-2026-85747 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3) is in registry/client.(*manifests).Get, which does not verify a fetched manifest against the requested digest; it is fixed in github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 v3.1.2, and github.com/docker/distribution ends at v2.8.3. portieris links three github.com/docker/distribution v2.8.3+incompatible packages: registry/api/errcode and registry/api/v2 through go.podman.io/image/v5/docker, and uuid through github.com/theupdateframework/notary/client/changelist. The portieris binary contains no github.com/docker/distribution/registry/client package and no manifests.Get symbol, so the vulnerable code is not present.

The module is linked into the opm binary installed from dhi/pkg-opm (pinned in this image). GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3 lists no patched release on the legacy github.com/docker/distribution v2 module path (<=2.8.3); fixed releases are on github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 (3.1.2 and later). operator-framework/operator-registry still pulls the v2 module transitively through docker/cli and oras-go, so replacing it with v3 breaks compilation until those dependencies migrate. This catalog image runs opm serve against the pre-staged file-based catalog at /configs; assessing whether registry/client digest-pinned manifest fetch is reachable in that runtime posture is in progress. A durable module bump belongs in package/main/opm when upstream can adopt distribution v3.

Affects github.com/docker/distribution bundled in the devfile-gem Go binary rebuilt in the gitlab-rails package and shipped under /srv/gitlab/vendor/bundle. The shipped binary is on the v2 module stream at 2.8.3+incompatible. CVE-2026-85747 is fixed in github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 v3.1.2 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3). devfile-gem must migrate from the v2 module stream to that v3.1.2 release before gitlab-rails is rebuilt with the fix. That migration is not yet validated.

CVE-2026-85747 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3) is a missing digest check in the github.com/docker/distribution registry client: manifests and blobs fetched by digest were returned without being hashed, so a malicious registry could substitute content. docker/distribution v2.8.3 has no fixed release; the fix shipped in distribution v3.1.2 as commits https://github.com/distribution/distribution/commit/8f91c26c8888a95a36c2357a6e30bc15d4dd76d3 (manifests) and https://github.com/distribution/distribution/commit/93c6e1a3b3c874a73fbd6b8fa9b37577223cff9e (blobs). The docker packages listed here apply both changes to the registry client vendored in Moby, so dockerd rejects manifest and blob content that does not match the requested digest. The module version reported by go version -m stays v2.8.3+incompatible because the fix is applied to vendored source. Advisory: https://github.com/distribution/distribution/security/advisories/GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3

CVE-2026-85747 (GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3) is fixed in github.com/distribution/distribution v3.1.2 by validating manifest bodies against digest-pinned requests in registry/client.(*manifests).Get. The cdi-uploadserver binary links github.com/docker/distribution v2.8.3+incompatible only as a transitive dependency of github.com/containers/image/v5/docker, which imports registry/api and registry/client/auth/challenge but not registry/client manifests. A go list -deps build of cmd/cdi-uploadserver at containerized-data-importer v1.66.1 does not include github.com/docker/distribution/registry/client, and the built binary has no manifests.Get symbol. The upload server serves HTTPS uploads and does not act as a distribution registry client performing digest-pinned manifest fetches, so the vulnerable code is not compiled into this artifact.

The affected module is linked only through the devfile-gem Go binary rebuilt in this image; backup-utility does not invoke it. GitHub Security Advisory GHSA for CVE-2026-85747 lists patched releases at distribution v3.1.2 on the github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 module path. Replacing the legacy github.com/docker/distribution v2.8.3 dependency with v3.1.2 breaks compilation because oras-go v1.2.5 and docker/cli v25 still import registry/client packages that v3 removed. Resolves when those dependencies can move to releases built against distribution v3.
